capabilities: Intercept plain link clicks to edit the link text instead of navigating
Require modifier keys (Ctrl/Cmd+Click) to follow links
Show a confirmation before creating a note for a link with no existing target
Preserve Obsidian's modifier-click behavior for opening links in tabs, splits, and windows
Handle wikilinks, wikilink and markdown embeds, internal markdown links, external URLs, and plain URL text
extras: README notes callout links rendered in Live Preview are not yet supported (listed as Todo), and rendered image embeds keep native Obsidian click behavior.
intentEvidence: modifies the default click behavior of bidirectional links
problem: In Obsidian, clicking a bidirectional link always navigates away, so fixing or editing a link inline is awkward.
summary: Link click modifier that makes plain clicks edit links in the editor and modifier-clicks navigate to the target.
